answer_1.quote: we propose ToneCraft, a novel framework that utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate Cantonese lyrics while respecting tonal and melodic harmony

answer_2.quote: Objective Metrics. We evaluate lyric diversity and melody-lyric alignment using several objective metrics.

answer_4.quote: We invited ten native Cantonese speakers as volunteers, all with basic music theory knowledge and an interest in literature.
answer_4.guideline: Volunteers scored lyrics from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent) based on criteria for lyric quality (diversity, fluency, coherence, poeticness) and lyric-melody alignment (harmonicity, listenability, ambiguity).
